description: This header file defines internal function prototypes for the Sys Setup Manager component in a system environment. It includes function declarations related to system state management, audit reactions, session management, and RCM interface notifications within the Sys Setup Manager.

methods.name: SysSmoGetSysRcmIf
methods.description: Retrieves the Sys RCM interface handle.

methods.name: SysSmoReactRfoAdded
methods.description: Handles reactions when an RFO is added.

methods.name: SysSmoReactRfoDeleted
methods.description: Handles reactions when an RFO is deleted.

methods.name: SysSmoReactRroAdded
methods.description: Handles reactions when an RRO is added.

methods.name: SysSmoReactRroModified
methods.description: Handles reactions when an RRO is modified.

methods.name: SysSmoReactRroDeleted
methods.description: Handles reactions when an RRO is deleted.

methods.name: SysSmoInitSetUpAccess
methods.description: Initializes setup access with a given key.

methods.name: SysSmoStopSetUpAccess
methods.description: Stops setup access associated with a given key.

methods.name: SysSmoRcmNotify
methods.description: Notifies RCM of an event related to a folder.

methods.name: SysSmoRcmInit
methods.description: Initializes RCM interface for a folder.

methods.name: SysSmoRcmStop
methods.description: Stops RCM interface for a folder.
